IEHC.description: Inelastic Hinge Control Data (IEHC). A single model-wide record (always key 1) controlling fiber-section discretization for beam-column and wall inelastic hinges; the fields have no per-TYPE switching, so all are supplied together.

BEAM_LOC.description: Reference location for distributed hinges: 0 = I-End, 1 = Center, 2 = J-End.

OPT_ConsiderRebarArea1D.description: Beam-Column: consider reinforcement (rebar) area in the fiber section.

FAreaSizeCore.description: Fiber beam areas, Core region sizing: 0 = Auto Size, 1 = Equal-Size.

BeamDivNumNy.description: Number of fiber divisions (Beam-Column), Ny (y-direction), Core region.

BeamDivNumNz.description: Number of fiber divisions (Beam-Column), Nz (z-direction), Core region.

FAreaSizeCover.description: Fiber beam areas, Cover region sizing: 0 = Auto Size, 1 = Equal-Size.

BeamDivNumNyCover.description: Number of fiber divisions (Beam-Column), Ny (y-direction), Cover region.

BeamDivNumNzCover.description: Number of fiber divisions (Beam-Column), Nz (z-direction), Cover region.

WallConsOut.description: Consider out-of-plane nonlinearity of plate-type (wall) elements.

WAreaSize.description: Fiber wall areas, Core region sizing. Case-insensitive: AUTO = auto size, EQUAL = equal size.

WallDivNumZ.description: Number of fiber divisions, z-direction, wall Core region.

WallDivNumY.description: Number of fiber divisions, y-direction, wall Core region.

WAreaSizeCover.description: Fiber wall areas, Cover region sizing: 0 = Auto Size, 1 = Equal-Size.

WallDivNumZCover.description: Number of fiber divisions, z-direction, wall Cover region.

WallDivNumYCover.description: Number of fiber divisions, y-direction, wall Cover region.

OPT_ConsiderRebarAreaWall.description: Wall: consider reinforcement (rebar) area in the fiber section.

dR.description: Shear spring location r (relative position along the wall).
